authorization.authorization_scope: Use the client-authorized shared production DAT login for read-only RateView and DAT One Search Loads discovery, testing, and on-demand operation. RateView may use fictional shipment data. Search Loads discovery must use fictional or otherwise explicitly approved shipment/lane data, and every Search Loads query requires approval for that one search. The Search Loads workflow may enter discovery-approved shipment/lane filters, execute the single approved search, read result rows, rank rows by the highest explicit displayed numeric offer, and return up to 10 rows to the CRM with comments and all discovery-approved visible non-contact fields. No application-level daily lookup cap applies to RateView. Booking, bidding, calling or otherwise contacting, messaging, posting, purchasing/payment, revealing contact details, downloading, deletion, account changes, and all other consequential DAT actions are not authorized.
authorization.approved_by: Jack (client approver and DAT account owner; surname and title TBD)
approved_environments: DAT production, limited to approved read-only RateView discovery and searches
DAT One production, limited to approved read-only Search Loads discovery and searches
authorization.production_use_constraints: Read-only RateView and Search Loads use with duplicate and uncertain-submission protection. Search Loads discovery uses only fictional or otherwise explicitly approved shipment/lane data, and each Search Loads query requires approval for one search. Search Loads may return only discovery-approved visible non-contact fields to the CRM; it must not reveal contact details or infer an offer from nonnumeric text. Always respect DAT's own subscription, credit, usage, and rate controls and stop before booking, bidding, calling or otherwise contacting, messaging, posting, purchasing/payment, revealing contact details, downloading, deletion, account changes, or any other consequential action.

workflow.name: DAT RateView lane pricing and DAT One Search Loads
workflow.business_purpose: Create a Playwright virtual employee that uses DAT RateView lane pricing and a read-only DAT One Search Loads result-ranking workflow as part of First Class Trucking's freight quote process.
workflow.trigger: On demand. Each Search Loads run requires documented approval for one validated search before submission.
inputs: Origin, destination, and equipment type are documented by DAT as RateView search inputs
Any additional inputs DAT RateView requires; the exact UI field list remains TBD pending authorized observation and confirmation

Approved shipment and lane filters for DAT One Search Loads; exact Search Loads UI fields, labels, required/optional status, allowed values, and normalization rules are TBD pending authorized browser discovery and confirmation
outputs: Displayed market-rate range: low, average, and high
Displayed rate type, timeframe, per-mile value, and fuel information when available
Up to 10 DAT One Search Loads result rows, ranked from highest to lowest by an explicit displayed numeric offer

For each returned Search Loads row: comments and all discovery-approved visible non-contact fields; any contact details within comments must not be revealed or returned, and the exact field set, redaction behavior, and CRM mapping are TBD pending authorized browser discovery
Search Loads rows without an explicit displayed numeric offer are not ranked as offers; exact exclusion or fallback presentation behavior is TBD pending discovery and client confirmation
workflow.existing_process_context: The existing CRM ingests quote emails. DAT RateView provides market benchmark data, and the requested DAT One Search Loads workflow returns ranked read-only load-result data to the CRM. The exact Search Loads result-field mapping remains TBD pending authorized discovery.
workflow.expected_volume: Approximately 10 RateView lookups per day was provided as an expected volume, not a maximum. Search Loads volume is TBD; each Search Loads query requires approval for one search.
workflow.schedule_or_sla: On demand; latency target and support hours are TBD
success_metrics: Five consecutive successful read-only searches using fictional data
For each approved Search Loads invocation, execute no more than one validated search and return no more than 10 result rows ranked by the highest explicit displayed numeric offer
Return Search Loads comments and only discovery-approved visible non-contact fields to the CRM; never reveal or return contact details
No duplicate or uncertain request is submitted again automatically
No booking, bidding, calling or otherwise contacting, messaging, posting, purchasing/payment, revealing contact details, downloading, deletion, or account changes
On authentication loss, pause for human reauthentication and resume from a safe pre-search checkpoint without duplicating a lookup or consuming an unintended extra lane credit
